column1: //step Your model | | A model can be shared as a link or an image or plain text. It can also be shown on its own inside other web pages.

//step The Links menu | The Links menu | Copy Link copies a web address that rebuilds the model. Download Image saves a picture. Mermaid Editor and Mermaid Code pass the diagram on to Mermaid's own tools.
//step Simple mode | Simple mode | Adding &simple to a model's web address shows only the model and its tour. It works with example names and file addresses but not yet with Copy Link addresses.
//step Other web pages | Other web pages | To show a model inside another web page use an iframe whose address ends with &simple. The model keeps its tour and pan and zoom.
//step Web address options | Web address options | The web address can open an example by name or a file from another site. It can also return just the Mermaid code.
//step Plain text | Plain text | The lines in the text box are the model. Save them as a text file or keep them in a spreadsheet and paste them back in later.
//step Other pages | Documentation pages | This is the last documentation page. Use these links to go back.
